metric_definitions.dropped_vehicle_ticks: meta.json n_dropped_slot_steps (featurizer n_dropped_concurrent): vehicle-ticks dropped because more than K_max=128 vehicles were present
metric_definitions.ticks_pool_full: ticks with all 128 slots occupied (upper-bound indicator set of drop-affected ticks; a drop requires a full pool, a full pool need not have dropped)
metric_definitions.counts_only: no outcome/label data read or reported
